title: Tottenham sign defender Cristian Romero from Atalanta
trail: Tottenham have signed the Argentina defender Cristian Romero from Atalanta on loan with an option for a €55m deal
body: Tottenham have signed the defender Cristian Romero from Atalanta on a season’s loan with an option for a €55m (£46.7m) permanent deal. The 23-year-old helped Argentina win the Copa América this summer. Romero arrived in England on Thursday to complete his medical and will not have to isolate because he is vaccinated, provided he returns a negative test on Saturday. His signing represents a coup for Tottenham, who have long been after a marquee centre-back. Romero was named Serie A defender of the year for his performances last season. Tottenham’s managing director of football, Fabio Paratici, was crucial to the move, having brought Romero to Juventus in 2019, though Romero did not end up playing for the Turin club. He came to Italy when he joined Genoa in 2018, Juve signed him a year later and immediately loaned him back to his former club. After continuing to impress for Genoa, Juve sent him to Atalanta on loan in the summer of 2020, with the option to buy for €16m. That represented good business for the Bergamo club. Romero made three appearances at the Copa América, including starting the victory against Brazil in the final. He follows his former Atalanta teammate Pierluigi Gollini to Spurs, the goalkeeper joining last month on a season’s loan with the option to buy. Spurs have also signed the winger Bryan Gil from Sevilla in a cash-plus-player deal that saw Érik Lamela go the other way.
